**Shaping Our Ai Capabilities

**Are you motivated by building the platform that powers a company's AI ambitions, alongside a team of highly skilled and similarly motivated engineers? Then you may just be the perfect fit for our Cloud Platform team in STARK Group IT.

We are at the early stages of establishing an AI Center of Excellence in partnership with the CTO Office, and our Platform team is building the infrastructure capabilities needed to support it, from hosting AI agents to enabling on-prem AI workloads. This is an opportunity to help shape those capabilities as they evolve.

**The mission, should you choose to accept it

**As our new Senior Platform Engineer, you will join our existing cloud team, taking responsibility for applying modern cloud disciplines and technologies to design and implement the Cloud Platform used by more than 17 development teams and powering solutions for our 20,000 global employees. Increasingly, that also means helping shape how AI is used across the company - working hand in hand with the CTO's office as they build out the AI Center of Excellence, contributing to what "good" looks like for agentic usage, cost and credit management, agent scaling, and building the platform capabilities that make it all work in practice.

This isn't just an infrastructure role. You'll help define guidance and best practices alongside the CoE, as well as build the platform underneath it - a rare chance to shape both the standards and the systems from the ground up. You'll become part of a highly performant, international team that gives you plenty of freedom in how you work, along with responsibility to make your own impact.

Your work with us will primarily, but not exclusively, revolve around the following areas:

• Expand our Azure Cloud capabilities, leaning on IaC as your main tool and following the principles of the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework.

• Build and operate the infrastructure for agentic AI workloads, including agent hosting, orchestration, and the platform capabilities needed to run them reliably at scale.

• Build toward a truly hybrid AI setup, pairing cloud-native AI capabilities with on-prem infrastructure so workloads can run wherever makes the most sense.

• Contribute to the guidance and standards coming out of the AI CoE, helping define what "good" looks like for agentic usage, credit and cost management, and agent scaling across the company.

• Strengthen and tune our Kubernetes workloads, making sure they run with the performance, resilience, and efficiency our business depends on.

• Drive a Platform Engineering approach to our cloud and AI infrastructure and tooling, working closely with Software Engineering teams and the AI CoE to build cohesive, developer-friendly experiences.

• Deliver on a modern, secure, and scalable cloud architecture, which you will help shape - one that's increasingly built with AI workloads in mind.

To succeed in this role, we are not just looking for someone who checks boxes - we're looking for someone honest, vocal, and unafraid to challenge the status quo when you see ways we can improve.

**Who are we looking for?

**So, if you enjoy spotting the glitches in the Matrix before anyone else does, or you’ve ever whispered "it's always DNS" to yourself (even when the culprit turned out to be a misbehaving agent), we consider that a positive sign.

Those qualities tend to go hand in hand with what we're looking for: someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, isn't afraid to challenge established ways of working, and combines technical depth with a pragmatic mindset, helping us build and evolve the platform capabilities that support both today's cloud services and tomorrow's AI ambitions.

The skills that will help you thrive include:

• A solid grasp of the Azure Cloud ecosystem, understanding both its opportunities and its boundaries.

• Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code, ideally with Bicep, and the ability to bring structure, clarity, and repeatability to how we build cloud resources.

• Comfort with scripting, whether your tool of choice is Python, Bash, or PowerShell, to automate tasks and streamline operational workflows.

• Experience with Kubernetes fundamentals, including deployments, services, and scaling.

• Curiosity about or exposure to AI infrastructure concepts - things like model hosting, agent orchestration frameworks, or GPU-backed workloads - even if you're not an AI expert yet.

• General familiarity with CI/CD and networking, giving you a well-rounded foundation for how we do cloud engineering.

**Welcome to Group IT

**When joining Group IT, you will be joining a digital transformation journey as we replace our legacy systems and transition towards a modular and flexible integrated setup. Group IT, a dynamic and rapidly evolving part of STARK Group, is responsible for delivering groupwide business-critical IT solutions. We strive to modernize and reimagine the IT landscape to ensure both scalability and composability to meet existing and future business needs, and we would like your help to rethink the way things are done in our industry to offer our customers a superior experience.

**Want to know more and apply?

**We will be happy to answer any questions you may have regarding the position and your options in STARK Group. You are welcome to contact Magnus Bech Larsen, magnus.larsen@stark.dk for any specific questions regarding the role.

The Impact You'll Make

**Do you enjoy building things, solving practical technical challenges, and turning ideas into working solutions?

**Then you may be the person we're looking for to help establish our new prototype team.

**As our Lead Technician, you'll play a key role in building and testing prototype refrigeration systems that support development activities across Danfoss.

This is a highly hands-on role where you'll use your technical experience to build custom prototype setups, troubleshoot technical challenges, and help bring concepts to life. You'll work closely with engineers, technicians, and internal stakeholders across Danfoss, ensuring prototypes are built efficiently and projects move smoothly from start to finish.

The environment is dynamic, with multiple activities running in parallel and a strong focus on practical execution. While you'll take the technical lead on projects, this is not a people management role. Success comes from your ability to organize work, coordinate activities, and apply your technical knowledge to deliver working prototype solutions.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**Working as part of a newly established prototype team, you'll combine practical technical work with project coordination responsibilities.

• Build and assemble prototype refrigeration systems and custom test setup

• Coordinate prototype activities from project kick-off through completion, ensuring tasks and workflows are organized and progressin

• Work from electrical, thermal, and P&ID drawings to build and troubleshoot prototype system

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Danfoss, including colleagues without an engineering backgroun

• Support testing, problem-solving, and continuous improvements to prototype solutions and working methods

**What We're Looking For

**You enjoy practical technical work and are comfortable taking ownership of activities from planning through execution.

**Essential Qualifications

**

• Educational background as a Marine Engineer, Automation Technician or similar technical discipline

• Experience building, assembling, or troubleshooting refrigeration systems or other complex technical equipment

• Experience coordinating technical tasks or projects in a workshop, manufacturing, service, or similar environment

• Ability to read and understand electrical, thermal, and P&ID drawings

• Working knowledge of AutoCAD, PCSCHEMATIC, or similar technical drawing tools

Knowledge of flow systems, fluid dynamics, and related technical documentation would be an advantage. Experience working with colleagues across different functions and locations is also beneficial.

**What You'll Get From Us

**You'll help engineer a better future by contributing to solutions that make a real difference around the world.

As part of a newly established prototype team, you'll have a unique opportunity to help shape how we work and influence the setup of future prototype activities. You'll work in a practical environment where ideas quickly become physical solutions and where your technical expertise will have a visible impact on projects across Danfoss.

We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths.

You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

You'll be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.

You'll receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you!

Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

For further information about the position, please contact our ADC team Manager, Nordborg, Thorsten Stöben, +45 5171 8579.

For information about the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Gerd Veierskov, +45 3057 1882

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Lead global customer success and drive commercial growth across some of the world’s most influential media organizations.

Do you thrive at the intersection of customer success, commercial leadership, and strategic relationship management? Are you motivated by developing existing enterprise customers through complex solution sales while acting as a hands-on leader for an international team?

On behalf of Stibo DX, we are seeking an experienced Vice President, Customer Success RoW to lead customer success activities across Rest of World markets and play a central role in the company’s continued transformation towards a SaaS and recurring revenue business model. RoW includes several strategically important markets for Stibo DX, including Denmark, the Netherlands, India, and other key markets across Europe and Asia-Pacific.

The Opportunity

As Vice President, Customer Success RoW, you will be responsible for driving customer retention, adoption, value realization, and commercial growth across Stibo DX’s global customer portfolio outside the DACH region and the Americas. This is a commercial leadership role focused on developing existing enterprise customers through complex, value-based solution sales. The role combines strategic account leadership, executive stakeholder management, commercial ownership, and people leadership of three people, and you will act as a hands-on player-coach for the team.

Based in Denmark, from either their headquarters in Aarhus or their Copenhagen office, you will report directly to the Senior Vice President, Customer Success Management.

You will lead the RoW Customer Success organization and be part of the global Customer Success leadership team alongside the regional leaders for DACH and the Americas.

You will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Professional Services, Support, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Executive Management to ensure customers maximize the value of their investment in the Cue Media Enterprise Platform while supporting Stibo DX’s ambitious growth objectives.

Key Responsibilities

As Vice President, Customer Success RoW, you will lead and further develop customer success across a strategically important international region that includes Denmark, the Netherlands, India, and other key markets across Europe and Asia-Pacific. You will support existing customers through complex business and technology transformations while driving commercial expansion across the portfolio. Your responsibilities will include:

• Owning Customer Success performance across the RoW region, including retention, Net Revenue Retention, adoption, customer health, and commercial growth within the existing customer portfolio.

• Leading and developing an international Customer Success team as a hands-on player-coach while creating a high-performance culture focused on measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

• Building trusted executive-level relationships with strategic customers and personally leading selected key customer engagements and complex commercial opportunities.

• Driving customer value realization and supporting customers in maximizing business impact from the Cue platform while identifying opportunities to expand Stibo DX’s solutions across their organizations.

• Identifying and managing customer risks and growth opportunities while balancing long-term customer success with commercial objectives and driving complex, value-based solution sales.

• Contributing actively to the global Customer Success leadership team and helping shape best practices, processes, and strategic priorities across regions.

The Ideal Candidate

You are an experienced and commercially minded customer-facing leader with a proven track record from Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, Enterprise Sales, Professional Services, Consulting, or a similar function within B2B software and SaaS environments.

You understand what it takes to build long-term strategic customer relationships and create sustainable growth within an existing customer portfolio. You are comfortable shaping and driving complex commercial opportunities, engaging new stakeholders within customer organizations, and leading value-based solution sales from initial opportunity through negotiation and agreement. At the same time, you are a capable people leader who enjoys acting as a hands-on player-coach, developing the team and creating momentum around complex customer opportunities.

You bring credibility in executive-level dialogues and are comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders across customer organizations as well as internally across functions and geographies. You combine a strategic mindset with a hands-on and distinctly commercial approach and are known for your ability to build trust, create alignment, and execute consistently.

Experience from subscription-based software businesses, SaaS transformations, or enterprise technology environments will be highly advantageous. Exposure to structured commercial methodologies such as MEDDPICC is considered a strong plus. Fluency in English is required. Additional language capabilities are considered beneficial, but not essential.

Why Join Stibo DX?

This is an opportunity to take on a highly visible leadership role at a company investing significantly in future growth, innovation, and product development. You will have direct influence on customer outcomes, revenue retention, and expansion across some of the world’s leading media organizations, combining people leadership with hands-on involvement in complex commercial projects.

You will join a global technology company with deep industry expertise, a strong financial foundation, and a long-term ownership model that enables continued investment in customers, people, and products.

As part of the global Customer Success leadership team, you will help shape how Stibo DX engages with customers worldwide while contributing to the company’s continued transition towards a SaaS-first business model. The role offers extensive international exposure across a strategically important RoW portfolio, including Denmark, the Netherlands, India, and other markets across Europe and Asia-Pacific, as well as close collaboration with colleagues across Denmark, Germany, Norway, Spain, and the USA.

Help empower storytellers across the globe

Stibo DX is the global leader in digital transformation for media enterprises. Their platform and services help automate complex content production and enable omnichannel delivery for some of the world’s most ambitious and successful media organizations.

They are a global and dynamic team of over 200 employees based in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Atlanta, Hamburg, Oslo, and Málaga, combining creativity and innovation with the stability of a long-standing organization.

Stibo DX is part of the Stibo Software Group, the second-largest Danish-owned software group. Their roots trace back to the Stibo Foundation, which has a 228-year history and a rich legacy that supports their continued growth.

Travel: Approximately 20-30 travel days per year, primarily across Europe, and other international markets within the RoW region

Are you passionate about renewable energy and eager to work at the forefront of the global energy transition? PEAK Wind is seeking an AI Engineer to help shape our AI roadmap and to build and orchestrate the agents our colleagues and clients will use every day. At PEAK Wind, AI is moving from prototypes into production, and renewable energy operations produce exactly the kind of complex, high-volume data where AI can deliver significant value.

Introducing the Data & Intelligence Team

You will become part of our Data & Intelligence (D&I) team, where we work within PEAK Wind’s asset management service offering and manage full value chain data management for our clients. We support renewable energy assets worldwide through data management, reporting solutions, analytics, and AI capabilities, helping deliver data-driven solutions that support our clients and renewable energy projects. Our team consists of highly motivated professionals who bring diverse backgrounds and a strong commitment to excellence. We support one another, share knowledge, and celebrate both individual and collective achievements.

You will report to the Head of Data & Intelligence and work day-to-day with our small team of engineers who have been building internal AI products at PEAK Wind for several years. You will work closely with colleagues across different areas, bringing your perspective to a collaborative and purposeful team environment.

How You Will Make an Impact

As an AI Engineer, you will take AI solutions from idea to production and keep them there. You will co-own our AI roadmap: helping decide which agents we build, in what order, and what “working” means for each of them. Then you will build them.

Our agent portfolio serves two audiences. Internally, our agents give colleagues across PEAK Wind a well-governed way to work with company knowledge, generate reports, and analyse wind farm performance. Other internal agents help our own engineers specify and build new features faster. Externally, we provide agent-driven capabilities in our client-facing products.

On smaller initiatives you may be the engineer primarily responsible for taking the solution from first conversation to deployment. On larger initiatives, you will work closely with Product Owners, data engineers, and domain experts in asset management. Either way, the distance from an idea to something running is deliberately short. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Co-develop and maintain the PEAK Wind AI roadmap with the AI team, turning business needs into scoped, sequenced deliverables

• Design, build, and deploy agentic systems for internal colleagues, from reporting and wind farm analysis to engineering-productivity agents

• Design, build, and deploy AI-driven features and agents in our client-facing products, working with SCADA, operations, and asset management data

• Orchestrate multi-agent workflows: tool use, memory, retrieval over company and client data, and integration with our platform through APIs

• Build the evaluation systems that tell us whether an agent works, before and after it reaches production

• Own the data and infrastructure work behind your own agents on the cloud.

• Implement responsible-AI practices for operational energy data: access control, data isolation between clients, logging, and guardrails

• Ship early and iterate put prototypes in users’ hands fast and feed what you learn back into the roadmap

• Collaborate with Product Owners and stakeholders to understand what they need, and push back when AI is not the right tool

• Document what you build so others can maintain, extend, and trust it

What Will Make You Successful in This Role

At PEAK Wind, we know success comes in many forms. What matters most is your mindset, curiosity, and drive to make an impact. The following qualities and experiences will help you succeed in this role:

• A degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or similar, or an equivalent track record of shipping software

• Hands-on experience in software development, ML, data engineering, or AI Engineering, including AI applications you have helped take into production

• Strong Python and/or TypeScript, and hands-on experience with at least one agent framework

• Experience building or extending evals for LLM and agent behaviour, or an interest in developing deeper expertise in this area

• Experience building in cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure; familiarity with PostgreSQL, APIs, and modern web stacks is an advantage

• You code with AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor as a matter of course

• Professional experience in the energy industry or another complex technical environment; renewable energy or SCADA experience is an advantage but not required

• Clear and effective communication skills in English, both spoken and written, with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike

• A go-doer mentality: you would rather ship something real this week and improve it next week than perfect it in a document

• A structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to take initiative, including owning a product from idea to delivery

• The ability to stay calm and constructive in a high-paced environment

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in an international, cross-functional team

This role is designed for an engineer who has already gained some hands-on experience building AI solutions and is now looking to deepen that expertise in a highly practical, production-focused environment and enjoys building and learning.

Why Join PEAK Wind

• A real mandate to build with AI: an existing roadmap, internal users who want what you build, and clients ready to adopt it

• An international, inclusive, and diverse workplace where differences are valued

• The opportunity to work on leading renewable energy projects alongside experienced industry professionals

• Flexible working arrangements that support both your career and personal life

• A flat organisational structure where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter

• A strong focus on your learning, development, and professional growth

• A culture that values commitment, meaningful contributions, and having fun

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Fair Hiring

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace drives innovation, creativity, and stronger results. At PEAK Wind, we are committed to fair and transparent hiring processes, welcoming candidates from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions focus on what each person brings to the role and our team, and we are committed to ensuring transparent salary structures, with pay decisions based on clear, objective, and gender‑neutral criteria. Salary information, including the relevant salary band, will be shared with candidates when they are invited to a first interview.

How to Apply

We look forward to receiving your application. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been found. Please apply directly through our website. If you have any questions or would like to know more about the position, please contact People & Development at recruitment@peak-wind.com.

About PEAK Wind

PEAK Wind is an independent renewable energy specialist in commercial, financial, and technical operations, delivering advisory, intelligence, and asset management services to investors and developers around the world. From onshore and offshore wind generation to Power-to-X, we work across the entire energy lifecycle to optimise operations and maintenance, enhance asset performance, and provide a holistic view of renewable infrastructure portfolios.

Our values - Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity - are reflected in everything we do, from how we support our clients to how we collaborate as a team. At PEAK Wind, you will be able to apply your professional skills in a dynamic environment and experience a meaningful responsibility and involvement.

At Factbird, we're redefining how manufacturing runs. By combining hardware, firmware, cloud, and AI, we turn raw production data into real, measurable impact on factory floors around the world. This is a product built by and for people who understand what happens on the shop floor. We’re on a mission to make it easier and faster for manufacturers to work smarter to increase productivity and eliminate waste.

For this mission we're building fast, scaling with purpose, and solving problems that matter. Now, we're looking for an addition to our product management team, who want to bring our product into the future by expanding upon how we create real value on the factory floor.

The position product management plays at Factbird is both high-impact and also hands-on. As a product manager here, you’ll set direction, own the roadmap, and drive execution from idea to launch and beyond. You’ll play a key role in shaping how our platform scales and how our customers succeed.

About the role

You’ll work closely with a dedicated development team and your peer product leaders, and you report to the Director of Product.

Production Insights: As a key platform application the candidate requires a strong PM backbone with a focus on having built products that communicate complex datasets and provide actionable insights to different user groups. To succeed in this role, previous experience from manufacturing industries is a key differentiator for us. Whether you have stood on that shopfloor and owned its numbers yourself or have worked for manufacturing and know exactly what "real value" means to the people running a production line – we take “knowing our customers” very serious for this particular position.

Key Responsibilities

• Turn strategy into shipped products: Define roadmaps, prioritize ruthlessly, and work closely with stakeholders to ensure we solve the biggest problems our customers are facing.

• Lead across disciplines: Act as the glue between product, firmware, cloud, UX, and business stakeholders - making sure everyone is aligned, focused, and moving fast.

• Identify signals in noise: Clarify customer needs, outline their jobs to be done and translate findings into clear and concise user stories.

• Spearhead continuous discovery: Build and maintain strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders to gather key insights.

• Launch, learn, iterate: Drive product launches, gather customer feedback, and continuously evolve features based on real-world usage.

• Own performance & outcomes: Define and track key performance metrics aligned with product objectives.

About you

You have experienced first-hand how a shop floor is operated to ensure targets are met and continuous improvements are realized. You thrive in environments where ownership is high, pace is fast, and impact is visible. You're comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and love turning complexity into clarity, because you've had to do exactly that on a production floor before.

You are curious about technology and are keen to figure out what it enables for people who live and breathe shop floor realities every day. You care deeply about understanding the underlying problem before working on a solution. You want to build products that drive real value, something customers depend on, not just move on to the next shiny thing.

Requirements

• Solid Product Management Experience: You are well-versed in product management frameworks and agile processes and can bring them into play with a practical approach, leveraging frameworks where they create clarity, structure, and speed.

• You've worked hands-on on the shopfloor for a while. You've been accountable for ensuring performance meets expectations by collaborating with the likes of operators, process engineers, continuous improvement leads, and plant or operations managers. This operational depth is what lets you translate real production pain into product decisions, and it is a hard requirement for this specific role — without it, the rest of the role is very difficult to do well. Our products play an essential role in manufacturing operations, and your experience within this field is essential.

• A continuous discovery mindset: You talk to customers constantly, map their jobs to be done, and identify commonalities. You're comfortable sitting with ambiguity until the real problem surfaces.

• Strong data and analytics instinct: Comfortable working with data and understanding how to turn analysis into concrete actions.

• A natural communicator: You speak the language of engineers, designers, operators, and leadership alike, adapting how you communicate to whoever's in the room.

• Driving teams: Proven ability to set and agree direction and goals with R&D teams, driving the team and getting to results in a manner where the team feels proud of the outcome.

Why Factbird?

People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here's what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn’t one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We’ll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we’ll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide kickoffs & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what’s next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We’re proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

We’d love to hear from you

If this role feels like a match, we’d be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out to Khristel, our Global Talent Acquisition & People Operations Lead at **khma@factbird.com

_Do you want to build production AI systems that change how the world’s largest dedicated fund manager within greenfield renewable energy deploys capital? If so, CIP Fund Solutions (CIP FS) is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Digital & AI team in Copenhagen, Denmark.

**Team

**As Forward Deployed Engineer, you will join the Digital & AI team in CIP Fund Solutions, reporting to the Investment Lifecycle Lead. You will be part of a new delivery unit, developing and rolling out digital and AI solutions that bring efficiency to CIP’s investment teams, and you will set the unit’s technical direction.

**Role

**As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you work alongside the investment teams who use your systems, learn the documents and decisions they handle, and turn that knowledge into production software.

You will design, build and run the AI systems that support CIP’s investment lifecycle, working with data rooms, contracts, financial models and investment committee materials, and you will set the engineering standards that let CIP scale AI across teams.

**Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:

**

• Design, build and run production AI systems for the investment lifecycle, owning integrations, reliability and monitoring.

• Build retrieval, document-processing and agent-based workflows over data rooms, contracts, due diligence reports and financial models.

• Define and run evaluations that test accuracy and reliability against CIP-specific benchmarks.

• Build in access control, data segregation between funds and audit trails from day one.

• Integrate with CIP’s Microsoft 365 and data platforms, working with IT and Security to run solutions as supported services.

• Set engineering standards and reusable components and help build the engineering team as the unit grows.

**You

**You hold a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, and bring 5-8 years of software engineering experience, including at least two years building LLM-powered systems in production. You write production code in Python plus TypeScript or C#, and have hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation, tool use and agents, structured extraction and model evaluation.

You also bring cloud engineering experience on Azure or a comparable platform, and a solid grasp of security and data governance in sensitive data environments.

Experience in financial services, energy or another regulated industry is a strong advantage.

**We look for the following in a candidate:

**

• Ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

• Enjoy working face-to-face with users and turning their feedback into working software.

• Calm and decisive when delivery is urgent and requirements are unclear.

• High standards and ownership, from prototype through to production.

• Excellent written and verbal English. Danish is not a requirement.

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.
